items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Belo Horizonte (MG) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1; proposals close Nov 21, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
